text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light:  ALERT: unusual auth traffic detected from auth-proxy in us-west-2. 401 spike + a small number of S3 GETs showing objects with partial headers. Possible leaked staging logs. Auto-created incident INC-5601.

alice_oncall: seeing it. I got paged. Investigating session patterns now.

ben_sre: on it — pulling recent access logs and proxy traces. can someone paste the suspicious S3 path?

incident-bot: Found object: `s3://redwood-staging-logs/proxy/2026-03-16/part-00023.gz` (md5: a1b2c3...). Accessed from ephemeral IPs: 34.82.11.99, 35.204.77.12.

carla_sec: :eyes: if those files contain auth headers we need immediate containment. Revoke any short-lived tokens issued in past 24h and rotate svcacct keys used by the staging forwarder.

ellen_infra: I can block the two IPs at the edge WAF and suspend the staging-forwarder role. Doing now.

ellen_infra: WAF rule applied to block 34.82.11.99, 35.204.77.12. Suspending `staging-log-forwarder` role in IAM (temporary).

ben_sre: fetching the file header sample now. snippet: ```
--- start ---
[INFO] proxy request: src=10.2.3.4 dst=auth-proxy:443 method=GET path=/v1/auth
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJI...
User-Agent: curl/7.79.1
--- end ---
```

alice_oncall: ack. That looks like partial tokens present. David, any customers impacted or staging tenants with sensitive data?

david_custsuccess: quickly checked our open support tickets, no customer reports yet. A few internal sandbox tenants could be affected. I'll prepare the comms draft for impacted customers if we confirm exposure.

carla_sec: action items: 1) rotate all tokens for services that wrote to the staging bucket in the last 48h, 2) rotate any long-lived keys for the forwarder, 3) run an S3 inventory for similar objects, 4) start a minimal audit for exfil destination. Assign owners?

alice_oncall: I'll own the token rotation (short-lived tokens + inform apps to refresh). Ben, you own log-file forensic and S3 inventory. Ellen, keep infra mitigations and make the role suspension permanent until review. Carla, lead the post-incident security review and customer impact decision. David will handle comms.

ben_sre: starting inventory: running `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-staging-logs --prefix proxy/2026-03-` to find related parts. Will snapshot matching objects to a quarantine bucket `quarantine-inc-5601`.

ellen_infra: role `staging-log-forwarder` suspended. created temporary deny policy. Also added CloudTrail filter to alert on `GetObject` for that prefix.

frank_oncall2: paging in 20m to take over — any immediate handoffs?

alice_oncall: handoff to Frank at 15:40 UTC. Current status: WAF blocks in place, role suspended, S3 inventory in progress, token rotation started (revoked ~6 short-lived tokens so far). Ben will upload quarantine list. Carla prepping escalation if customer data present.

ben_sre: uploaded quarantine manifest to `s3://quarantine-inc-5601/manifest-5601234567.txt` with 6 objects. Download sample for analysis.

carla_sec: recommended: rotate service account keys and perform KMS key-rewrap for any objects encrypted with shared keys. Also recommend enabling server-side encryption enforce for staging.

ellen_infra: doing KMS rewrap for objects we control. Enforced SSE for the staging bucket (bucket policy updated).

david_custsuccess: comms draft (internal only): "We detected suspicious access to a subset of staging logs that may contain partial authentication headers. Production systems not affected. We're rotating keys and blocking suspicious sources. We'll notify impacted teams within 3 hours after forensic confirmation." Thoughts?

carla_sec: language looks good. Add that we are not aware of customer data exfiltration at this time and that we will provide timely updates.

alice_oncall: timeline: T+0m alert, T+5m WAF block, T+10m role suspend, T+18m inventory started, T+25m token rotation begun, T+40m quarantine manifest uploaded. Next: forensic analysis of 6 objects (Ben) and final impact decision.

frank_oncall2: taking over. I'll coordinate next steps, update INC-5601, and start a 1:1 with Ben and Carla in #incident-warroom. If anything breaks from token rotation, ping me.

incident-bot: Incident INC-5601 updated: severity=high, status=mitigating, assignees=[alice_oncall, ben_sre, carla_sec, ellen_infra, david_custsuccess]. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/INC-5601

alice_oncall: leaving now — handing off full notes to Frank. Please post final impact conclusion in the ticket and mark customer comms go/no-go.

ben_sre: initial forensic: 2 objects contain truncated Bearer tokens, tokens expired naturally within 6h for most users, but 1 token appears valid for another 12h — rotated and revoked. No sign of exfil to external buckets beyond the two ephemeral IPs. More deep dive continues.

carla_sec: preserve all artifacts (snapshots, manifests, CloudTrail logs) for 90 days. Start legal/compliance notification checklist pending impact confirmation.

frank_oncall2: acknowledged. I'll coordinate the checklist and update the incident in 30 minutes. Good job team — nice quick mitigation. :lock:
